items.why: Caught in the chip sell-off as investors cool on AI hardware names; Baird noted Wall Street is tiring of what it called 'the Bank of AMD.'
Fear gauge climbing as tech shares fall for a second day and hot wholesale inflation stirs rate hike worries.
Treasury yields falling as investors rotate into bonds during the equity sell-off; the 10-year sits at 5.04.
Down with the broader chip wipeout amid a roughly $1 trillion sector drawdown; Baird flagged fatigue with 'the Bank of Nvidia.'

market_note: Nasdaq futures off 1% while Dow futures hold higher; yields falling as money rotates defensive.
summary: Tech is leading a second straight day of selling, with chip stocks deep in the red after a hot wholesale inflation reading revived rate hike worries.
